title: Bug: ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm fan3 ... RPM [ALARM]
author: arista-hpandya
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

These errors appear on Arista 72800DR3A SKUs. Pmon expects psu fan3 and fan4 to be readable but this particular model only has two psu fans, the rest need to be ignored.

```qzd543 ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm: Chip dps800-i2c-22-58: vin: +0.00 V (min = -0.50 V, max = -0.50 V) [ALARM]
qzd543 ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm: Chip dps800-i2c-22-58: fan3: -1 RPM [ALARM]
qzd543 ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm: Chip dps800-i2c-22-58: fan4: -1 RPM [ALARM]
qzd543 ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm: Chip dps800-i2c-21-58: fan3: -1 RPM [ALARM]
qzd543 ALERT pmon#sensord: Sensor alarm: Chip dps800-i2c-21-58: fan4: -1 RPM [ALARM]
```

### Steps to Reproduce

These logs will appear when the pmon daemon starts on the switch. No special steps are needed to reproduce.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected: Pmon should not complain about PSU fans that do not exist
Actual: Pmon complains about non-existent psu fans 3 and 4
